name: Majo Shinpan -Injoku no Judgment-
original_name: 魔女侵犯 －淫辱のジャッジメント－
source:
A small medieval European nation nestled in the Alps... known to neighboring countries as a strictly religious state, surrounded by jagged, sword-like peaks that repelled invaders, it thrived as a realm with its own unique state religion.

Lawrence Fitz, an ugly man plagued by insecurities, lived his life cursing his own existence. Then one day, a turning point came. After an accident, a priest he’d crossed paths with helped him secure work as a church servant.

It was the peak of the witch hunts. After witnessing countless heretics vanish into flames, Lawrence, who harbored a sadistic streak, eventually joined the interrogations. Then came an order: interrogate a certain woman. Lady Alicia, a noble’s wife accused of witchcraft — a woman even the church’s inquisitors couldn’t break.

"Make her confess to being a witch by the next Sabbath."

With permission to use any means necessary, a humiliating ordeal in the dungeon began....

[Translated from the [url=http://blue-topaz.jp/products/majyo/majyo_top.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
阿尔卑斯山中坐落着一个中世纪欧洲小国…邻国都知道，这是个宗教戒律森严的国家。周围剑刃般嶙峋的群峰阻挡着侵略者，使它得以作为一个拥有独特国教的王国繁荣发展。

劳伦斯·菲茨相貌丑陋，又饱受自卑困扰，一直诅咒着自己的存在。直到某天，转机降临了。一场意外过后，一名与他偶然相识的神父帮他在教会谋得了仆役的工作。

当时正值猎巫运动的顶峰。目睹无数异端消失在烈焰中后，暗藏施虐倾向的劳伦斯最终也加入了审讯。随后，一道命令传来：审问一名特定的女子。她是贵族之妻艾丽西亚夫人，被控施行巫术——就连教会的审判官也无法令她屈服。

“在下一个安息日前，让她承认自己是女巫。”

在获准不择手段之后，地牢中的屈辱折磨就此开始…

[Translated from the [url=http://blue-topaz.jp/products/majyo/majyo_top.html]official site[/url]]
